featureList: Custom column mapping (Title, Start Time, End Time, Description, Location)
Automatic Google Calendar Event ID writeback preventing duplicates
Dynamic two-way update detection for modified spreadsheet rows
Background time-driven trigger automation (hourly and daily schedules)
LockService mutex concurrency protection against race conditions
Support for all-day events, timed appointments, and multi-day workshops
100% private in-account execution via non-restricted scopes
One-time lifetime license — zero recurring SaaS subscriptions
